Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the IT and Marketing/communication Administrator role at your international association in Brussels. With a technical background in front-end development and hands-on digital marketing experience, I sit exactly where this position lives: between marketing campaigns and the code that makes them work.

I also bring SEO, CRM, and design-asset experience from working with tools like Canva and Photoshop.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your e-blasts, newsletters, and website maintenance. Thank you for your consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the IT and Marketing/communication Administrator position at your international association in Brussels. Your job description asks for someone who can move between Mailchimp campaigns, WordPress maintenance, and hand-coded landing pages. That is precisely the mix I have built my career on.

At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, content, and website management for client sites, including a WordPress/Elementor platform for a pharmacists' association with around 600 member profile pages. At Knowledge Experts, I built SharePoint-based digital workplaces and designed WordPress sites from structure to content and social integration. Earlier, as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I worked directly with AngularJS and JavaScript on a healthcare web application. Across these roles, I have used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript daily, managed CMS updates, and worked with analytics tools to report on performance.

I am comfortable with email marketing workflows: building audiences, scheduling campaigns, and coordinating content with copywriters and designers. I understand CRM basics, responsive design, and how to convert Photoshop assets into clean, W3C-compliant front-end code. I also bring SEO and GEO knowledge, which helps emails and landing pages get found and perform.

I am fluent in English, based in Belgium, and used to managing multiple projects and deadlines. I would be glad to provide examples of my work and discuss how I can support your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Baver Ok
